annotations.title: Ask the person to do something only they can

description: Puts a task in the person's approvals for something only a person can do, which you found is needed: a form or declaration in App Store Connect or Play Console that no store API takes (App Privacy, Play's App content forms, Apple's regulated medical device and EU trader declarations), an agreement only the Account Holder accepts, a click in a store's console. Ploa files these itself when a store stops a request (ploa_person_tasks lists them): ask for one only when it isn't there. Give it as numbered steps, each with the exact answer and, where it's done, its link and button words. The dashboard is in English or Hebrew and Ploa doesn't translate: steps and title in English, and he with the same in Hebrew. firstTimeOnly: true when only the first time is the person's and later times you or Ploa do it (a first release from a console). part: the store details part it is, when it's one of them (Did it then marks it done there too). Then walk the person through it in chat in their language, step by step with the links, and give them the task's address in Ploa that this returns. Never for something you can do yourself, and never to get around an approval.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

firstTimeOnly.description: Only the first time is the person's; later times are done for them.

he.description: The same title and steps in Hebrew, for a dashboard in Hebrew.

button.description: The button's words for the link (Open App Information).

text.description: What to do in this step, with the exact answer to enter.

link.description: The main page where it's done (https).

part.description: The store details part it is, when it's one of them.

button.description: The button's words for the link (Open App Information).

text.description: What to do in this step, with the exact answer to enter.

title.description: A short title, in English (Declare the medical device status at Apple).

what.description: Instead of steps: the same as one text (older form).
